test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the area of the sector of a circle of radius 8 cm formed by an arc of length 12 cm?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of an arc = 12 cm

Radius of circle = 8 cm

**Formula used:**

Length of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360

Area of sector = (π × R2 × θ)/360

**Calculation:**

Length of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360

⇒ 12 × 360 = 2 × (22/7) × 8 × θ

⇒ θ = (12 × 360 × 7)/(22 × 16)

⇒ θ = (3 × 45 × 7)/11

⇒ θ = (945/11)° 

Area of sector = (π × R² × θ)/360

⇒ (22/7) × (8)² × (945/11) × (1/360)

⇒ 2 × 16 × 3 × (1/2) = 16 × 3

⇒ 48 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Area of sector = l × r/2

⇒ 12 × 8/2

⇒ 12 × 4

⇒ **48 cm²**
